== Convention hub rewrite (25 October 2026) ==
=== Build notes ===
* [[DecipherCon 1999]] rewritten as the convention container (2000 outline). SWCCG Worlds stays on [[1999 Decipher World Championship]]. Wild Card stays on the Worlds hub; the convention Thursday row links there.
* Score-sheet inventory (Wayback CDX, 31 unique 200s): ST01_1, ST02_1, ST03_1, ST11_1, ST21_1, ST30_1; SW01_1, SW02_1, SW03_1, SW10_1, SW10_2, SW11_1, SW11_2, SW12_1, SW21_3, SW22_1, SW22_2, SW23_1, SW30_1, SW30_2; YJ02_2, YJ03_1, YJ04_1, YJ05_1, YJ12_1, YJ20_1, YJ20_4, YJ20_5, YJ30_1, YJ30_2, YJ30_3.
=== Missing data ===
* No CDX copy: SW05 Invitational, SW06 Team scores, SW20 Enhanced Sealed, SW21_1, SW21_2, SW23_2, SW24 EPP Overdrive, ST04 Finals, YJ01 Qualifier #1, YJ06 Finals. Scheduled-heat sentences sit on the event pages. YJ Qualifier #1 top 8 is from Lalumiere Friday. ST Finals (Harrington over Allman) and YJ Finals (Heisler over Reed) are from Lalumiere Saturday.
* Format popups with no CDX copy: playerschoice.html, swallegiancesmulti.html, japanesesealed.html, eighthmanevents.html, swinvitational.html, swenhancedsealed.html, swdeckbuildingclinic.html, swproductdevelopment.html. Format hubs for Players' Choice and Allegiances use "Decipher's own description of the event is not preserved".
* ''whosplaying.html'' is a JavaScript stub, not a roster. Attendee union is the SW score sheets (286 unique names). Wild Card 147 and Japanese Sealed 149 share 72 names.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Lalumiere Thursday counted 146 Star Wars Wild Card players in progress; SW01_1 lists 147.
* Special guests page prints "JEREMY BULLOCK"; the article uses [[Jeremy Bulloch]]. Lalumiere Saturday prints "Shannon Baska"; the article uses [[Shannon Baksa]].
* Team Event winner list stays Akesson / Feldman / Meijssen / Lapointe (Trandosite + Torch). See earlier Team Event section.
* Identity dests: Paul Feldman → [[Paul Todd Feldman]]; Clint Hayes → [[Clint Hays]]; Piergiulio Narolulli → [[Piergiulio Nardulli]]; Bastian Wikelhaus → [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]; Markus Wuest / Markas Wuest → [[Markus Wüst]]; Koen Meyssen → [[Koen Meijssen]]; Nick Burke → [[Nicholas Burke]]; Nick Reisch → [[Nathan Reisch]]; Dan Sotelo → [[Daniel Sotelo]]; Joseph Sottile → [[Joe Sottile]]; Chris Kagehiro → [[Christopher Kagehiro]]. Dan / Matt / Jim Sokol stay distinct. Hunter Paschal and Hayes Paschal stay distinct. Kim / Kyle / Kerry Codoley stay distinct.
* [[DecipherCon 1999 SW Iron Man]] now redirects to [[DecipherCon 1999 Iron Man]] (Friday SW11_1 + Sunday SW11_2).
* [[1999 Decipher World Championship ECC Sealed]] stays a separate article (Lush's unofficial Saturday-night sealed). Official SW.20 is [[DecipherCon 1999 Enhanced Sealed Deck]] (Lalumiere 176).
